CLI_VERSION.description: Specific version of cli to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

CLI_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install CLI. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise' or 'asdf' defers to third-party tools.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

CLI_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for CLI to listen on

CLI_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for CLI to listen on

CLI_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for CLI to listen on

GCP_CLI_ENABLED.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating whether gcp-cli is enabled in the execution plan.

GCP_CLI_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation method for gcp-cli (libscript_native, system, or from-source).

GCP_CLI_VERSION.description: Specific version of gcp-cli to install (e.g., latest, lts, or exact version).
